sections.heading: What is career guidance, and why does India need it?
body: Career guidance is the process of helping someone understand their strengths, interests, and options, and then choose a practical, realistic career path. In India, this is almost entirely missing — schools and colleges rarely offer it, and a single session with a private career counsellor costs ₹2,000–₹8,000, which most students and families cannot afford.

The result is millions of capable people stuck in confusion: graduates with degrees but no direction, BPO workers who feel trapped, and students who pick courses based on peer pressure instead of fit. Latecomers AI exists to fix exactly this — affordable, practical, India-specific career guidance for the people the system forgot.

sections.heading: How AI makes career guidance more structured
body: Traditional career counselling depends on one counsellor's limited knowledge and a generic personality test. AI changes this. By analysing your education, interests, work style, budget, and income timeline together, Latecomers AI matches you to careers that genuinely fit — and then builds a month-by-month roadmap for each.

Because it is software, this guidance scales to everyone at almost no cost. You get the depth of a structured assessment plus a real action plan — what to learn, which free courses to take, what salary to expect, and which jobs to apply for — with a paid plan starting at Rs 9.

h1: Confused About Your Career? Here's How to Find Your Path
intro: If you keep thinking 'I am confused about my career' or 'what career should I choose?' — you are not alone, and you are not stuck. Latecomers AI helps confused students and graduates turn that confusion into a clear, practical next step in five minutes.

sections.heading: Why so many Indian students feel confused about their career
body: Career confusion in India has clear causes: degrees that don't translate into jobs, fifty different voices giving conflicting advice, no career counselling in most colleges, and a deep fear of choosing wrong and 'wasting' years. With so much noise and so little guidance, most people freeze and do nothing.

The freeing truth is that there is rarely one single 'right' career — there are usually several good-fit options. The goal is not to find a perfect match before acting; it is to find a practical, realistic path you can start now and adjust as you learn.

sections.heading: How to move from confused to clear
body: Clarity does not come from more thinking — it comes from a structured process and one small action. Here is the path out of confusion:
bullets: Audit yourself: what do you enjoy, what are you good at?
Narrow 100 options to a few career families that fit
Reality-check with real job postings, not relatives' advice
Research your top option deeply for 7 days
Build one small proof of skill and start applying

sections.heading: How Latecomers AI removes the confusion
body: Instead of staring at a blank page, you answer a 5-minute quiz about your background, interests, and goals. Latecomers AI then gives you a focused shortlist of careers that fit — with a roadmap, salary, and courses for each. It turns an overwhelming question into a clear set of options you can act on.
It will not make the decision for you, but it removes the paralysis. You go from 'I have no idea' to 'here are my three best options and exactly how to start the first one.'

sections.heading: You don't need certainty — you need a confident first step
